dog.description_text: Meet Creed! Creed just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here's what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQDd2-pMixVLQqx2JnQsJ8jaAcYZRXQYkwt1bfLF2v1kNKQ?e=aNeF8f Creed is 23 pounds and is 6 1/2 years old. We don’t have much background information or many personality notes yet, but we’ll be updating their profile as we get to know them better. Every day reveals something new, and we’re excited to learn all the little quirks, preferences, and habits that make them unique. His foster says "The first day he was shy and he wanted to check everything to make sure he’s safe, now is very curious and loves cuddles.". Creed is neutered and vaccinated and has been microchipped and given preventative treatments so that he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. For any additional questions, please contact fosternyc@bestfriends.org. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
